answer: Locks are logged in basalt, expire in harbor, and cipher lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 13 aliases as a result needs 98 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2574 identities would post 1810 proofs and burn roughly 10 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
